releaseNotes: Initial MailMyPDF plugin submission: secure document workflow discovery and execution, owner-scoped matters, quarantined attachment intake, analysis and drafting, exact PDF/recipient/price review, explicit packet approval, Stripe-hosted checkout preparation, and mailing status/tracking.

list_saved_addresses.readOnlyHint: True because it reads only the connected owner's saved addresses.
list_saved_addresses.destructiveHint: False because selection never changes data or approves mail.
list_saved_addresses.openWorldHint: False because it accesses a private bounded address book, not public search.

save_mailing_address.readOnlyHint: False because it persists a user-confirmed address from a verified mailing.
save_mailing_address.destructiveHint: True because it may replace an existing address or change the default sender.
save_mailing_address.openWorldHint: False because it reads existing verification and writes only private account data.

archive_mailing_address.readOnlyHint: False because it archives an owned saved address.
archive_mailing_address.destructiveHint: True because it removes an address from active selection and may clear the default.
archive_mailing_address.openWorldHint: False because it only updates a private owned record; historical mailings are unchanged.

get_mailing_context.readOnlyHint: True because it reads only recent direct-mail orders belonging to the connected account.
get_mailing_context.destructiveHint: False because it cannot change addresses, approvals, payment, or mailing state.
get_mailing_context.openWorldHint: False because it searches bounded private account history, not public address directories.

review_direct_pdf_mail.readOnlyHint: False because it records server-verified postal-address evidence for the draft.
review_direct_pdf_mail.destructiveHint: False because review never approves, pays, or submits mail.
review_direct_pdf_mail.openWorldHint: True because it checks postal deliverability with Lob and obtains a current price.

ingest_direct_pdf.readOnlyHint: False because it stores a user-authorized PDF in the secure quarantine vault.
ingest_direct_pdf.destructiveHint: False because uploading and scanning do not approve, charge for, or mail a PDF.
ingest_direct_pdf.openWorldHint: True because it downloads an assistant-provided HTTPS file and may contact the malware scanner.

prepare_direct_pdf_mail.readOnlyHint: False because it creates an unpaid mailing order from an owner-scoped clean PDF.
prepare_direct_pdf_mail.destructiveHint: False because an unpaid draft order does not approve the PDF or send mail.
prepare_direct_pdf_mail.openWorldHint: True because pricing may query the external payment provider for account entitlements.

approve_direct_pdf_mail.readOnlyHint: False because it records the user's explicit approval of exact PDF, price, and mailing details.
approve_direct_pdf_mail.destructiveHint: False because approval alone does not charge a payment method or submit physical mail.
approve_direct_pdf_mail.openWorldHint: True because current-price validation may query the payment provider for entitlements.

prepare_direct_pdf_checkout.readOnlyHint: False because it creates or reuses hosted checkout for the previously approved mailing.
prepare_direct_pdf_checkout.destructiveHint: False because the user must complete payment separately on hosted checkout.
prepare_direct_pdf_checkout.openWorldHint: True because it contacts Stripe to create or retrieve a hosted checkout session.

get_operation_status.readOnlyHint: True because it only reads the authenticated owner's persisted operation status.
get_operation_status.destructiveHint: False because polling cannot replay, approve, pay for, or mail an operation.
get_operation_status.openWorldHint: False because it reads bounded MailMyPDF operation records without contacting providers.

get_connector_readiness.readOnlyHint: True because it diagnoses configured capabilities using bounded health probes without executing the requested workflow.
get_connector_readiness.destructiveHint: False because diagnostics cannot create orders, approve documents, take payment, or submit mail.
get_connector_readiness.openWorldHint: True because readiness probes may contact configured external service providers.

find_workflow.readOnlyHint: True because it only searches the static MailMyPDF workflow catalog and changes no state.
find_workflow.destructiveHint: False because it cannot delete, overwrite, send, charge, approve, or otherwise change user or external state.
find_workflow.openWorldHint: False because it searches only MailMyPDF's bounded workflow catalog and does not access the public internet.

get_workflow.readOnlyHint: True because it only returns metadata for one canonical MailMyPDF workflow.
get_workflow.destructiveHint: False because it changes no user, workflow, payment, or mailing state.
get_workflow.openWorldHint: False because it reads only the bounded MailMyPDF workflow catalog.

get_profile.readOnlyHint: True because it resolves only the profile represented by the already-validated OAuth credentials.
get_profile.destructiveHint: False because it cannot modify the account or any user data.
get_profile.openWorldHint: False because it reads only the connected MailMyPDF account.

create_matter.readOnlyHint: False because it creates a new owner-scoped matter in the user's MailMyPDF workspace.
create_matter.destructiveHint: False because matter creation is reversible workspace state and does not approve, charge, send, or mail anything.
create_matter.openWorldHint: False because it writes only inside the authenticated user's bounded MailMyPDF workspace.

list_recent_matters.readOnlyHint: True because it only lists compact matter metadata belonging to the connected MailMyPDF account.
list_recent_matters.destructiveHint: False because listing recent matters cannot change documents, approvals, payments, or mailing state.
list_recent_matters.openWorldHint: False because it reads a bounded private account list and never searches public or third-party data.

get_matter.readOnlyHint: True because it only retrieves an owner-scoped matter and attached document metadata.
get_matter.destructiveHint: False because it performs no write or external action.
get_matter.openWorldHint: False because it reads only the authenticated user's bounded MailMyPDF workspace.

get_order_status.readOnlyHint: True because it only reads MailMyPDF's persisted order, payment, mailing, tracking, and sanitized event state.
get_order_status.destructiveHint: False because it does not poll providers, submit mail, charge payment, or mutate the order.
get_order_status.openWorldHint: False because it reads only the authenticated user's bounded MailMyPDF order records.

get_document_status.readOnlyHint: True because it only reads security/readiness metadata for a document already attached to the user's matter.
get_document_status.destructiveHint: False because it cannot alter, delete, scan, or release the document.
get_document_status.openWorldHint: False because it reads only the authenticated user's bounded MailMyPDF matter.

ingest_document.readOnlyHint: False because it copies a user-authorized attachment into MailMyPDF quarantine storage and attaches it to a matter.
ingest_document.destructiveHint: False because it creates quarantined workspace data but does not overwrite existing files, approve a packet, charge, or mail.
ingest_document.openWorldHint: True because it retrieves a temporary public HTTPS attachment URL supplied by the AI client before storing the validated bytes.

save_matter_input.readOnlyHint: False because it persists validated workflow facts to the user's matter.
save_matter_input.destructiveHint: False because it updates reversible matter data and has no payment, mailing, deletion, or other irreversible external side effect.
save_matter_input.openWorldHint: False because it writes only inside the authenticated user's bounded MailMyPDF matter.

analyze_matter.readOnlyHint: False because it runs analysis and persists analysis state/results on the matter.
analyze_matter.destructiveHint: False because it does not delete or overwrite approved artifacts, charge, approve, or mail.
analyze_matter.openWorldHint: True because the analysis path may call the configured external LLM provider.

generate_draft.readOnlyHint: False because it generates and persists draft workflow state.
generate_draft.destructiveHint: False because the generated draft remains reviewable/editable and is not approval, payment, or mailing.
generate_draft.openWorldHint: True because draft generation may call the configured external LLM provider.

save_draft.readOnlyHint: False because it persists the exact reviewed draft text as current matter state.
save_draft.destructiveHint: False because it changes reversible draft state and cannot approve, charge, or mail.
save_draft.openWorldHint: False because it writes only inside the authenticated user's bounded MailMyPDF matter.

preview_packet.readOnlyHint: False because packet preview may persist measured page-count metadata while building the immutable review artifact.
preview_packet.destructiveHint: False because it does not approve, charge, submit mail, or irreversibly alter user data.
preview_packet.openWorldHint: False because packet construction and pricing use bounded MailMyPDF workflow/account data.

approve_packet.readOnlyHint: False because it records explicit approval of the exact packet hash, recipient, mail class, and quoted total.
approve_packet.destructiveHint: False because approval alone does not charge a payment method or submit mail and stale/changed packets require a fresh approval.
approve_packet.openWorldHint: False because it records approval only inside the authenticated user's bounded MailMyPDF matter.

prepare_checkout.readOnlyHint: False because it creates or reuses an approval-bound order and Stripe-hosted Checkout Session.
prepare_checkout.destructiveHint: False because it does not accept card credentials, charge the user, or submit mail; payment still requires user action on hosted checkout.
prepare_checkout.openWorldHint: True because it communicates with Stripe to create or retrieve the hosted Checkout Session.

get_workflow_state.readOnlyHint: True because it only reads owner-scoped matter, workflow, document, draft, approval, and order state to derive safe next actions.
get_workflow_state.destructiveHint: False because it cannot change workflow state, approve a packet, create checkout, charge payment, or submit mail.
get_workflow_state.openWorldHint: False because it derives guidance only from bounded MailMyPDF records and registered workflow contracts without contacting external providers.

manualSubmissionRequirements: Verify the publisher developer/business identity in the OpenAI Platform organization used for submission.
Ensure the submitter has Apps Management write permission.
Deploy the production MCP endpoint and run the current tool scan.
Complete the portal-generated domain verification challenge.
Provide reviewer demo credentials that work without MFA, SMS, or email confirmation.
Record and provide the required demo-recording URL.
Exercise all five positive and three negative review cases against the deployed plugin.
Confirm public website, support, privacy policy, and terms pages match the verified publisher.
Select only countries/regions where product, legal terms, and support are ready.
